title: CAD workshop part spec
description: Structural contract for specs/<part>/spec.yaml. The spec is the single source of truth for model and tests; structural errors must be caught here (tools/validate_spec.py, also a CI step) before any model reads the file. Semantic correctness (right dimensions, functional sense, matches the sketch) stays a human-gate question.

part.description: Part identifier. Must match the specs/<part>/ directory name (enforced by tools/validate_spec.py).

description.description: What the part is, where it came from, and which owner corrections shaped it.

units.description: All spec dimensions are millimetres; no other unit is accepted.

drawing.description: Provenance of the dimension-bearing artifact: 'none' (synthetic spec) or 'generated' (dimensioned drawing rendered from this spec by tools/render_drawing.py; hand sketch kept private by owner decision).

dimensions.description: Every modelled dimension in mm. Keys are part-specific, but every value must be a positive number; length and width are required by the drawing pipeline, and a solid needs at least three dimensions.

features.description: Part-specific features (holes, pockets, ribs, legs...). Deliberately open: per-feature semantics belong to the part's model and tests, not to a shared schema.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance (mm) applied to all automated checks against measured geometry.

uncertain.description: Items whose interpretation is not settled. Every entry must be resolved (or explicitly accepted) in verification.md before human acceptance. An empty list is the explicit 'nothing uncertain' statement.

assumptions.description: Explicit, veto-friendly interpretations of the source sketch. Each veto must cost one parameter change, not re-modeling.
